title: Set Mismatch
summary: Given an integer array nums representing a set of integers from 1 to n with one number duplicated and one number missing, identify the duplicated and missing numbers and return them as an array.
statement: Given an integer array nums representing a set of integers from 1 to n with one number duplicated and one number missing, identify the duplicated and missing numbers and return them as an array.
constraints: 2 <= len(nums) <= 10,000; values are from 1 through n.
Exactly one value occurs twice and exactly one different value is missing; return [duplicate, missing].
reference_solution:
def find_set_mismatch(nums):
    expected = len(nums) * (len(nums) + 1) // 2
    duplicate = sum(nums) - sum(set(nums))
    missing = expected - (sum(nums) - duplicate)
    return [duplicate, missing]

def find_set_mismatch(nums):
    expected = len(nums) * (len(nums) + 1) // 2
    duplicate = sum(nums) - sum(set(nums))

    return [missing, duplicate]
hints: The duplicate is the excess over the distinct sum; the missing value completes the expected 1..n sum.
Use arithmetic sums and the set of observed values.
Removing one copy of the duplicate leaves exactly the intended set minus the missing number.
